name: Hayward Hideaway: Modern Garden Cottage
summary: Steps to Hayward Field & UO! This brand-new private studio is your luxury basecamp. Treat yourself to HEATED FLOORS, a cozy fireplace, and a full kitchen. Tucked in a quiet garden setting, you’re a short walk from Sweet Life Patisserie and campus events. Fast WiFi, workspace, and premium linens included. Managed by a local Superhost to ensure a seamless 5-star experience. Perfect for track fans, parents, and business travelers!

sections.title: The space
sections.text:
The Space Welcome to your private garden retreat! This brand-new, detached studio is designed for seamless, barrier-free living.

The open-concept layout is highly efficient: your plush double bed flows immediately into the full kitchen and dining area—no hallways or tight corners to navigate. You can hop out of bed and be pouring your morning coffee in seconds.

The modern bathroom is also directly adjacent to the sleeping area, offering easy access day or night. Inside, you’ll find the studio’s crown jewel: luxurious HEATED FLOORS that make every morning feel like a spa day.

Whether you are curling up by the electric fireplace, working at the dedicated desk, or cooking a meal in the fully stocked kitchen, the space feels open, airy, and incredibly functional.

sections.title: Guest access
sections.text:
Private & Secure You have exclusive access to the entire studio cottage and your own private patio area for outdoor dining.

Parking: Forget the stress of street parking! You have a dedicated parking spot in the driveway, secured behind a locked gate. You will receive a code for the gate prior to arrival, allowing you to pull right up to your private entrance for easy unloading.

The studio sits behind the main house in a shared garden setting, but your space is completely separate and private.

sections.title: Other things to note
sections.text:
The gated driveway area is safe and there is a fantastic park directly across the street for morning walks.

Climate Control: The studio is equipped with A/C for warm summer days and an electric fireplace (plus those amazing heated bathroom floors) to keep you cozy in the winter.

Work Ready: High-speed WiFi makes this an ideal spot for remote work or studying.
